notice: This path anticipates MCP Server Card discovery. The current official Registry manifest is server.json.
name: ai.afmr/discovery
title: AFMR Discovery
endpoint_note: Canonical endpoint is /api/rpc; /mcp is served as an equivalent alias for convention-following clients. JSON-RPC messages use POST; GET may return 405 when the stateless server does not offer an SSE listening stream.
scope_notice: AFMR records are scoped to named evidence, configuration, governance process, and lifecycle state. They are not unqualified universal safety claims.
